text:
alex: FYI, noticed 3 preemptible GPUs in us-west1 evicted around 15:23 UTC. Several low-latency streams dropped mid-token. Anyone saw similar? @mira

mira: saw it — logs show graceful termination window ended before stream cutover completed. :grimacing:

devon: what SLOs did those routes have? were they pinned to spot-only pools?

alex: yes, l0-chat-route is mixed but we accidentally scaled it to prefer preemptible during last cost test. we got lower cost but higher tail error.

sam: TL;DR: need a runtime pattern to avoid token-loss on SIGTERM: 1) graceful drain, 2) stream cutover token, 3) requeue incomplete requests.

jen: +1. Also need backpressure on requeue so we don't swamp on-demand pool during mass preemption.

mira: propose small change to agent lifecycle: on SIGTERM send "CUTOVER" to proxy -> proxy attaches client to fallback model instance and continues stream. if fallback not ready, proxy buffers tokens for up to 10s then requeue.

alex: sketch:

```
onSIGTERM():
  mark node.drain=true
  stop accepting new sessions
  for stream in inflight:
    emit CUTOVER(token_id, last_ack_offset)
    attempt proxy.handoff(stream, target_pool=on_demand_fast, timeout=10s)
    if handoff_fail:
      push request_id -> durable_requeue_queue
```

devon: durable_requeue_queue should include client hints + model_version + kv-cache checkpoint pointer. we need proto to reconstruct KV cache.

mira: agree. KV checkpoint example: base64(kv_window) + seq_no. can't be huge; limit to first 64KB.

sam: Also metrics: preempt.evictions, handoff.success_rate, requeue.rate, token-loss-count. Add alert if token-loss > 0.1% in 5m.

k8s-bot: Pod termination notice: pod/redwood-runtime-abc123 scheduled for deletion due to PreemptibleInstanceEviction. terminationGracePeriodSeconds=30.

jen: that 30s is tight. Might push to 60 for safer handoff, but GCP may not honor beyond provider window.

alex: ops plan: implement cutover token + requeue TTL 5m, add canary on staging with 5% traffic, runbook update, and emergency flag to prefer on-demand for L0 if eviction rate > 0.5%.

mira: i'll draft PR for agent and proxy changes. devon can you design KV checkpoint proto? sam to add metrics/dashboards and runbook entries.

devon: will do. Suggest using delta-compressed KV and a small checksum.

jen: action: run a simulated mass-preempt test next Thursday 09:00 UTC, use canary to validate no token-loss and <1% added latency.

alex: thanks all. leaving thread open — ping if you hit blockers.
